verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own Integration Server API, with generated credentials and an OAuth2 flow for acting on behalf of users, so programmatic agent access exists. Its in-product AI can also categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses in plain language. However, nothing in the evidence shows the API reading uncoded transactions or writing categories and coding back, and no MCP server is mentioned. missing for 10: documented API endpoints to list uncoded transactions, API write-back of categories/GL coding/tags, policy-flag proposals via API, MCP server, a review/approval handoff for agent-proposed coding, independent hands-on corroboration.
